verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Abacum serves an llms.txt at abacum.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an agent-readable product summary covering integrations, consolidation, roll-ups and the demo, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Its content is a product overview rather than in-depth technical documentation, and the probes found no markdown doc variants and no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: deeper agent-oriented technical docs (e.g. llms-full.txt or .md page variants, since /product/intelligence.md returned 404), a machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration of agent use.
